mapper.sql: select id, order_no, user_id, job_id, amount, status, wechat_transaction_id, refund_no, pay_time, refund_time, request_id, create_time, update_time from job_signup_order
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc, id desc

select jso.order_no, dj.id as job_id, dj.title, dj.work_date, dj.work_time, dj.location, dj.salary_day, jso.status, case when sir.id is null then 0 else sir.sign_status end as attendance_status, case when sir.id is null then '未签到' when sir.sign_status = 1 then '已签到' when sir.sign_status = 2 then '迟到' when sir.sign_status = 3 then '已取消' else '未签到' end as attendance_status_label, sir.sign_time, sir.sign_image_url, case when sir.id is null then 0 else ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) end as audit_status, case when sir.id is null or ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) = 0 then '未提交' when sir.audit_status = 1 then '待审核' when sir.audit_status = 2 then '已通过' when sir.audit_status = 3 then '已驳回' else '未提交' end as audit_status_label, sir.audit_remark, case when sir.id is null then true when ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) = 3 then true else false end as can_upload_sign_image from job_signup_order jso inner join daily_jobs dj on dj.id = jso.job_id left join sign_in_record sir on sir.job_order_id = jso.id and sir.record_type = 3 where jso.user_id = #{userId} and jso.status = #{paidStatus} order by dj.work_date asc, dj.id desc

select sir.id, sir.id as record_id, jso.job_id, coalesce(ui.id, 0) as user_info_id, jso.user_id, case when up.real_name is not null and up.real_name != '' then up.real_name when up.nick_name is not null and up.nick_name != '' then up.nick_name when ui.user_name is not null and ui.user_name != '' then ui.user_name else '未注册用户' end as display_name, ui.user_name, case when ui.phone is null or ui.phone = '' then '' when char_length(ui.phone) < 7 then ui.phone else concat(left(ui.phone, 3), '****', right(ui.phone, 4)) end as phone_masked, jso.order_no, case when sir.id is null then 0 else sir.sign_status end as attendance_status, case when sir.id is null then '未签到' when sir.sign_status = 1 then '已签到' when sir.sign_status = 2 then '迟到' when sir.sign_status = 3 then '已取消' else '未签到' end as attendance_status_label, sir.sign_image_url, case when sir.id is null then 0 else ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) end as audit_status, case when sir.id is null or ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) = 0 then '未提交' when sir.audit_status = 1 then '待审核' when sir.audit_status = 2 then '已通过' when sir.audit_status = 3 then '已驳回' else '未提交' end as audit_status_label, sir.audit_remark, sir.sign_time, sir.submit_time, sir.audit_time from job_signup_order jso left join user_info ui on ui.user_id = jso.user_id left join wx_user_profile up on up.uid = ui.id left join sign_in_record sir on sir.job_order_id = jso.id and sir.record_type = 3 where jso.job_id = #{jobId} and jso.status = 1 order by ifnull(sir.submit_time, sir.sign_time) desc, ui.id desc, jso.id desc

select jso.id as order_id, jso.order_no, jso.user_id, jso.job_id, dj.title as job_title, case when up.real_name is not null and up.real_name != '' then up.real_name when up.nick_name is not null and up.nick_name != '' then up.nick_name when ui.user_name is not null and ui.user_name != '' then ui.user_name else '未注册用户' end as user_name, jso.amount, jso.status, case when sir.id is null then false else true end as signed_in, jso.pay_time, jso.refund_time, ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) as audit_status, case when sir.id is null or ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) = 0 then '未提交' when sir.audit_status = 1 then '待审核' when sir.audit_status = 2 then '已通过' when sir.audit_status = 3 then '已驳回' else '未提交' end as audit_status_label, sir.sign_image_url, case when jso.status = 1 and ifnull(sir.audit_status, 0) = 2 then true else false end as can_refund from job_signup_order jso inner join daily_jobs dj on dj.id = jso.job_id left join user_info ui on ui.user_id = jso.user_id left join wx_user_profile up on up.uid = ui.id left join sign_in_record sir on sir.job_order_id = jso.id and sir.record_type = 3 where jso.job_id = #{jobId} and jso.status in (1, 2) order by jso.pay_time desc, jso.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into job_signup_order (id, order_no, user_id, job_id, amount, status, wechat_transaction_id, refund_no, pay_time, refund_time, request_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{jobId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{wechatTransactionId}, #{refundNo}, #{payTime}, #{refundTime}, #{requestId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
